apps.name: Ferrum Editor
apps.summary: A small, hackable text editor in the spirit of Atom, written from scratch in Rust.
apps.description: Lightweight, hackable text editor: tree view, tabs, fuzzy finder and command palette.
highlights: Tree view, tabs, split panes, fuzzy file finder and command palette
Multi-cursor editing, find and replace, find in files, tree-sitter highlighting
Config, keymap, theme and snippets in plain TOML, applied live
CI page: GitHub Actions runs, job logs, workflow dispatch and PR checks
Logs page: live logs of the project's files, dev servers and containers

apps.name: FerrumAPI
apps.summary: Local-first, Postman-style API client. No backend, no account, no webview.
apps.description: HTTP/API client: collections, environments, history and code generation.
highlights: Local mock server per collection
Webhook inspector with replay
Load test with p50/p90/p99 latency

apps.name: FerrumGIT
apps.summary: Local-first Git client with a commit graph and per-project SSH profiles.
apps.description: Git client with commit graph, staging, diffs and profiles.
highlights: GitHub and GitLab pull requests: review, checkout, create, merge
File history, blame and side-by-side diffs
Undo for commit, amend and checkout; per-project SSH profiles

apps.name: FerrumData
apps.summary: Local-first database IDE for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SurrealDB, MongoDB and Redis.
apps.description: Database IDE: connections, SQL editor and result grid.
highlights: Redis key browser, value viewer and command console
Query history, CSV/JSON export and sortable, resizable grid
Column and index details for SQL tables

apps.name: FerrumTerm
apps.summary: GPU terminal for humans and AI agents, with persistent server-side sessions.
apps.description: GPU terminal with sessions, windows and panes.
highlights: Saved SSH hosts and ~/.ssh/config hosts in one click
Port forwards that keep running, and what's using a port
Agents sidebar for Claude Code and Codex

apps.name: FerrumKit
apps.summary: Everyday developer utilities in one native window: no websites, nothing leaves your Mac.
apps.description: Developer utilities: JSON, Base64, JWT, regex, timestamps, hashes and more.
highlights: JSON, YAML and TOML formatting, validation and conversion
JWT decoder, Base64, URL, hashes, UUID/ULID and timestamps
Regex tester, text diff, case and line tools

apps.name: FerrumContainers
apps.summary: Native container manager for Docker Desktop, OrbStack and Colima, and Podman via DOCKER_HOST.
apps.description: Container manager for Docker, OrbStack, Colima and Podman engines.
highlights: Containers grouped by Compose project, with live CPU and memory
Live logs, inspect, and a shell in FerrumTerm
Images, volumes and networks with prune

apps.name: FerrumPorts
apps.summary: See which process is on port 3000, and stop it, without lsof.
apps.description: Listening ports and the processes behind them: open, inspect or stop them.
highlights: Every listening port with its process, command and project
Open in the browser, copy, or stop a process safely
Free-port check and well-known port hints

apps.name: FerrumEnv
apps.summary: A password-locked vault for your projects' .env files, shared encrypted between developers.
apps.description: Password-locked vault for project environment variables, shared encrypted between developers.
highlights: Projects, environments and variables behind a master password, locked after 30 minutes
Encrypt a project's whole env with its team key and send it; teammates decrypt with the same key
Import and write .env files, and compare environments

apps.name: Ferrum Launcher
apps.summary: Installs, updates, rolls back and launches every Ferrum app.
apps.description: Installs, updates and launches the Ferrum apps.
highlights: Every version comes from GitHub Releases, with checksums verified
Stable and Beta update channels per app
Keeps several versions so you can switch back in one click
